title: Incremental SCIM reconciliation queue and reviewer assistant
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build an incremental SCIM reconciliation pipeline and reviewer assistant to power quarterly access certifications and reduce noisy diffs. Goals: 1) Support delta-only SCIM ingestion (adds/updates/deletes) with idempotent processing and backpressure, 2) Produce a prioritized reviewer queue with consolidated change summaries and confidence signals (SCIM source, SSO assertions, recent activity), 3) Emit audit-evidence artifacts per reviewer action (signed export CSV + JSON manifest) and retention metadata for compliance exports, 4) Provide operator controls for replaying deltas, snapshotting state, and backfilling missing events. Acceptance criteria: - End-to-end delta processing with <5m lag for typical orgs and bounded memory usage, - Reviewer UI receives consolidated queue items showing why access changed and last activity, - Generated evidence exports include deterministic hashes and timestamps and are discoverable via the console retention API, - Feature gated behind org-level policy flags and tested with synthetic SCIM feeds from Okta and Azure AD. Implementation notes: Use Kafka topic partitioning by tenant for ordering, employ a small RocksDB state store for per-tenant last-processed cursor, implement anti-entropy snapshots every 24h for reconciliation, and add a lightweight scorer service to rank queue items by risk. Integrations: SCIM delta webhook, SAML/SSO assertions ingestion, IAM audit log join. Links: Confluence (https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/SCIM-reconcile-runbook), RFC (https://redwood.link/rfc-scim-delta), prototype PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2241).
